scheme_name: National Pension Scheme For Traders And Self Employed Persons
other_conditions: Applicant must be self‑employed (shop owner, retail owner or other small‑scale trader)
Annual turnover of the business must not exceed ₹1.5 crore
benefits_summary: A guaranteed monthly pension of ₹3,000 after age 60, with a 50 % family pension for the spouse on the beneficiary’s death.
documents_required: Bank passbook, cheque leaf or bank statement (proof of bank account)
